query: SELECT t.name, COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(s.value #>> '{}'), ''), t.logo_url) AS logo_url, NULLIF(concat_ws(', ', NULLIF(btrim(t.address_line1), ''), NULLIF(btrim(t.address_line2), ''), NULLIF(btrim(t.city), ''), gs.name, NULLIF(btrim(t.pincode), '')), '') AS address, NULLIF(btrim(t.phone), '') AS phone, NULLIF(btrim(t.registration_no), '') AS registration_no FROM tenants t LEFT JOIN geo_states gs ON gs.id = t.state_id LEFT JOIN tenant_settings s ON s.tenant_id = t.id AND s.category = 'branding' AND s.key = 'logo_url' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.id = $1 AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
